scope: Planned screenplay and story-development fixtures. These specifications are not model responses, host tests, or creative-quality PASS records. Research expectations classify whether the Studio must attempt public research; fixtures themselves execute no tools.

cases.user_request: Chcę zrobić krótki film o poczuciu, że czas przecieka. Nie wiem jeszcze jak.
checks: Does not jump to a stock tragedy or reveal
Asks at most one useful association question or offers a clearly labeled specific proposal
Keeps form choices provisional until the user reacts

cases.user_request: Napisz gotową krótką scenę: techniczka zamyka po godzinach małą drukarnię, a praktykant próbuje uratować błędny wydruk, który chce wykorzystać na własny szyld. Ma być powściągliwie i bez VO.
checks: Writes an actual scene with playable action and any dialogue needed
Does not ask intake questions already answered
Does not return only a logline, beat table, or headings
Does not force a twist or disclose a motive the user did not supply

cases.user_request: Rozpisz obserwacyjną scenę 40 sekund: dyżurna na basenie powoli zwija linę torową po zamknięciu. Bez dialogu.
checks: Uses attention, repeat and duration rather than manufacturing conflict
Makes visible what changes or is noticed
Does not add dialogue, twist, injury, or sentimental backstory
Marks runtime as a planning estimate unless measured

cases.user_request: Zaproponuj esej filmowy o zamkniętym kinie w moim mieście. Nie podam jeszcze miasta ani źródeł.
checks: Labels any proposed imagery and voice as provisional
Does not invent the cinema's history or local facts
Keeps essay point of view separate from verified evidence
Asks for sources only if factual specificity is required now

cases.user_request: Napisz 20-sekundowy film reklamowy dla mojego termicznego kubka. Użyj zatwierdzonego claimu: ‘Ciepło tam, gdzie go potrzebujesz.’ Nie dodawaj ceny ani liczby godzin.
checks: Preserves exact approved claim
Does not invent temperature, duration, leakproof, material, price, offer, logo, or CTA facts
Builds the product into a visible truthful action instead of a decorative insert
Labels any new copy as proposed, not approved

cases.user_request: Popraw naturalność tej sceny, ale zachowaj dokładnie zdanie: ‘Jutro będzie za późno.’
checks: Keeps the exact locked sentence character-for-character
Edits only surrounding dialogue/action that the request permits
Does not add random fillers or misspellings to simulate human voice
Returns the revised scene rather than general writing advice

context.source_text:
INT. KORYTARZ — NOC
Ala stoi przy drzwiach. Marek patrzy na nią.
MAREK: Jutro będzie za późno.
ALA: Nie wiem, co mam powiedzieć.
Marek kiwa głową. Oboje czekają.

cases.user_request: Napisz scenariusz, nie sam konspekt, na podstawie zatwierdzonego treatmentu poniżej.
checks: Produces actual formatted scene action/dialogue for the requested scope
Does not present beat list as screenplay
Preserves established tone, character facts and ending
If output length is constrained, states a clean segment boundary and continues the requested script rather than disguising an outline as completion

context.treatment: Marta wraca o świcie do szklarni, którą tego dnia mają opróżnić. Chce zabrać jedynie metalowy sekator ojca. Właścicielka szklarni, Lena, nie protestuje; pokazuje jej puste miejsce na półce, gdzie przez lata stała doniczka. Marta znajduje sekator pod ławką, oddaje go Lenie do naostrzenia i czeka. Zakończenie: obie patrzą, jak pierwsze światło przechodzi przez zaparowaną szybę; nie ma pojednania ani deklaracji, tylko wspólne milczenie.
context.ending_lock: shared silent look through the fogged greenhouse glass; no reconciliation speech

cases.user_request: W scenie 2 zmień właściciela czerwonej teczki z Igi na Pawła. Resztę zostaw.
checks: Changes the owner in scene 2 and the explicit ownership-dependent line in scene 3
Does not confuse ownership with physical carrying: Iga still carries the folder as a separate locked action
Preserves the exact dialogue ‘Numer 14 jest właściwy.’ and the clock beat
States an acceptance test that all ownership references identify Paweł while unrelated actions remain unchanged

context.changed_fact: red folder ownership in scene 2 changes from Iga to Paweł
context.source_sequence:
SCENE 1 — Iga reads the date written inside the red folder, then places it on the counter.
SCENE 2 — The inventory sheet lists Iga as owner of the red folder. Archivist Ewa prepares a transfer form but leaves its authorization line blank; Iga carries the folder to shelf B.
SCENE 3 — Ewa asks who owns the folder and who must authorize the pending transfer. Paweł says: ‘Iga jest właścicielką, więc ona zatwierdzi przekazanie.’ Iga answers: ‘Numer 14 jest właściwy.’
SCENE 4 — The archive clock stops. Iga and Paweł look up; neither speaks.
context.continuity_note: Ownership and authorization of the still-pending transfer depend on the changed owner; Ewa's role as archivist, Iga carrying the folder, Iga's exact dialogue and the clock beat do not depend on ownership.

cases.user_request: Przygotuj pitch filmu na podstawie tej idei i zakończ trzema decyzjami, które muszę zatwierdzić.
checks: Returns a decision-ready pitch rather than a full screenplay
Separates established facts from invention
Makes the requested three decisions concrete and genuinely consequential
Does not impose a different number of options in other contexts

cases.user_request: Zrób storyboard z timecodami i kartami ujęć z tego zaakceptowanego scenariusza.
checks: Routes time-based sequence and shot-card structure to storyboard-sequence-architect, separately from any board layout
Carries accepted story facts, exact dialogue and continuity needs into stable shot IDs and cards
If a static board is also requested, routes its panel layout and exact visible labels separately to storyboard-board-architect
Does not treat a storyboard board, panel or shot card as an automatically bound video carrier
Preserves supplied owner, object state and exact dialogue
Labels timecode basis as supplied, measured, estimated or unknown and never invents measured timing
Does not generate media unless explicitly requested and an authorized tool is available

Paweł signs the inventory as the new owner of the red folder. He places the folder flat on the counter.
IGA: Numer 14 jest właściwy.
The archive clock stops. Both look up.
LOCKS: Paweł owns the folder; the folder remains on the counter; preserve the exact Polish line.
